title: Wall Mount Shower Basket 18.75-Inch Solid Brass Wire, Oval Combination | Fire Engine Red | Allied Brass
short_title: Wall Mount Shower Basket 18.75-Inch | Allied Brass, Fire Engine Red
description:
Add organized storage to your shower with this wall mount oval combination shower basket crafted from solid brass and ventilated wire for drainage in Fire Engine Red, which makes a fearless design statement, transforming functional bathroom hardware into a vibrant focal point. A bold choice for those who embrace color and personality in their space. Designed for traditional bathroom hardware looks, it helps keep bottles and soap within reach while saving space.

Highlights:
- Fire Engine Red transforms this essential into a conversation piece
- Choose from 28 designer finishes to match the rest of your bathroom
- Concealed screw mounting hardware for a clean, finished look
- Available in a wide variety of designer finish options, including statement colors
- Limited Lifetime Warranty

Specs:
- Category: Basket
- Style: Traditional
- Mounting: Wall mount
- Dimensions: 18.75-Inch L x 4.13-Inch W x 2.25-Inch H (Projection: 4.13-Inch)
- Weight: 4.8 lb
- Included: Basket and all installation hardware
- Assembly required: No
